title: Event notification suite: tail each repo's beads mutation log and publish typed events to ntfy

comments.author: JollyEmber
comments.text: Implemented internal/events: tails each repo's events table (br's own audit log) via sqlite3 -readonly through a monotonic cursor; publishes to ntfy firehose topic with ev-/repo-/node-/actor-/agent-/from-/to- tags + JSON body; assignee_changed AND created-with-assignee route to agent-<name> dispatch topics. At-least-once, ordered, first-run-at-tip, rebuilt-db cursor reset, per-repo failure isolation. title: Forwarded identity is trusted from ANY peer — direct :8438 callers can forge a verified actor
description: identify() honors Tailscale-User-Login and X-Forwarded-For no matter who the transport peer is. Through caddy this is now safe (the beads-*.caddy sites strip the user header; caddy appends its observed address to XFF and PeerAddr takes the last entry). But any tailnet peer that hits the systemd-socket-proxyd port (100.110.83.42:8438) DIRECTLY can set either header and mint a verified actor — and because proxyd erases the TCP peer before the unix socket, the daemon cannot tell caddy from a direct caller. Real fix: retire proxyd by letting the daemon listen on the socket AND a TCP address at once (-listen becomes additive), then honor forwarded headers only when the direct TCP peer is in a trusted_proxies config list (pi = 100.79.209.73); a direct non-proxy TCP caller gets whois on its own RemoteAddr instead — strictly better identity than today. Socket connections (0600, same uid) keep current behavior. Until then the exposure is tailnet-only, all first-party boxes.

title: omabeads: live refresh from ntfy beads-events instead of polling
One bad repo path in config crash-loops the whole daemon
description: Startup validation stats every configured repo path and exits on the first failure, so a single stale entry (deleted repo, path invisible to the unit — PrivateTmp hides /tmp, for example) takes every other repo down with it, and systemd auto-restart loops forever. Discovered while wiring omabeads' add-repo cog: a path that existed for the caller but not inside the service namespace killed 14 repos. omabeads defends itself with backup/health-poll/rollback, but the daemon could instead serve the repos it can stat and report the bad one as ok:false with an error — the shape GET /v1/repos already has.

title: Ship the TCP bridge units — the https story in the repo
description: The arch box carries hand-written beads_watch-proxy.socket/.service (systemd-socket-proxyd, tailnet IP :8438 -> unix socket) that back https://beads-arch.dev.a44.io via caddy on pi. They live only in ~/.config/systemd/user. Ship them in systemd/ next to beads_watch.service, and rewrite the README architecture section: tailscale serve is gone; the chain is caddy on pi (wildcard *.dev.a44.io, DNS-01, tailnet-bound) -> systemd-socket-proxyd on the box's tailscale IP -> the 0600 unix socket.
close_reason: systemd/ now ships beads_watch-proxy.socket (+ per-box IP install note) and beads_watch-proxy.service; arch's ~/.config copies are symlinks into the repo like the daemon unit; README architecture/identity/security/install rewritten for the caddy chain and verified live (health via socket, :8438, https from arch and dev; forged Tailscale-User-Login and XFF both resolve to whois truth through caddy). Residual direct-:8438 forgery filed as bw-mub.

title: Switch tailscale serve from localhost TCP to the unix socket
description:
Currently served as: tailscale serve --bg --https=443 http://127.0.0.1:7717. The unix socket is preferred (mode 0600 shuts out other local users; localhost TCP does not). Serving a unix socket requires root, so this needs one operator command:

  sudo tailscale serve --https=443 off
  sudo tailscale serve --bg --https=443 unix:/run/user/1000/beads_watch.sock

Then restart the daemon without --listen so it binds the socket from config.

title: Deploy beads_watch to dev, serving beads-dev.dev.a44.io
description: dev (100.70.239.127) has br/bv/herdr, linger on, 8 beads repos (~/dev/claude-watch ctxhooks herdr-bridge mc scripts, ~/boxset ~/bui ~/skills), no beads_watch.
